pages.text: The $(bold)Wagon Companion$(reset) task finds a non-driving position on a two- or three-seat bench. $(bold)Wagon Passenger$(reset) finds a free cargo stool with clearance. Changing tasks makes the maid dismount.$(br2)Lead and Carry On boarding also follow her task rules; otherwise she leaves immediately.

At rest time, any task can seek maid beds or wagon mats using the original priorities. Sleep follows a moving wagon; removing the mat wakes her without an added affection penalty.$(br2)Filled photos or soul talismans can release a maid on the wagon. Capture keeps the original restrictions, including the camera’s sleeping-maid rules.
